name: Selfless
overview: Scripture reveals that being selfless is rooted in the example of God's sacrificial love, who gave His only Son so that believers might have eternal life (John 3:16). This selflessness is reflected in the fruit of the Spirit, which includes love, patience, and kindness (Galatians 5:22). Christians are called to esteem others above themselves with humility (Philippians 2:3) and to love sacrificially, as husbands are instructed to love their wives just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself for her (Ephesians 5:25). These verses collectively emphasize selfless love as a defining mark of the believer’s life.
